title: Nyansa Nne a Ɛwɔ Sunsuma Mu
intro: Onipa bi a ofi tete mmere mu a wonim no sɛ ɔwɔ nhumu a emu dɔ no kasa kyerɛ wo wɔ mfehaha pii mu. Saa onipa yi ankyerɛ da sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifo, nanso ɔsoro nyansa sen fa wɔn nsɛm mu. Ɔwofo a ogyaw akwankyerɛ agyapade a ɛtra hɔ daa, wɔn afotu da so ara wɔ ɔpepem pii koma mu, wɔkenkan na wosusuw ho de besi nnɛ.
clues: Me nsa kaa ɔsoro akyɛdeɛ bi a ɛmaa me da nsow - nyansa a emu dɔ araa ma ɛbɛyɛɛ me su a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ me mu wɔ abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu.
Na mennye somafoa anaase obofoo - okra a wohyiraa no wo nteasee a emu dɔ ne nhumu wɔ wiase no mu kɛkɛ.
Ná abusuabɔ a ɛbɛn me paa ne me ba no, na ɛnam saa abusuabɔ yi so no, wɔde me nkrasɛm a ɛtra hɔ daa sen biara no mae.
Mehyɛɛ aseda ho nkuran maa Nea ɔmaa me biribiara, na mebɔɔ ​​kɔkɔ wɔ ahantan ne ahantan ho.
Mekyerɛkyerɛɛ sɛnea nneyɛe a ɛsom bo te sɛ sinapi aba mpo mu duru, ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ obi brɛ ne nne ase wɔ ahobrɛase mu no ho ade.
Ti bi a ɛwɔ Kur’aan mu no kura me din, baabi a wɔkora m’afotuo a mede maa me ba dɔfoɔ no so daa nyinaa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
